findings.description: The adapter no longer passes DEFAULT_CA_BUNDLE_PATH through extract_zipped_paths. If the default CA bundle path points inside a zip archive, such as a zipapp or a zipped package, os.path.exists fails on it.
findings.rationale: Trigger: requests runs from a zip archive and verify=True, so DEFAULT_CA_BUNDLE_PATH is a path inside the zip. Mechanism: the raw path is no longer extracted, so os.path.exists(cert_loc) is False. Impact: an OSError about an invalid CA bundle path is raised on every HTTPS request, which is a regression for zipped deployments. The new comment says certifi extracts the file, but certs.where() is evaluated at import time and may return a path that was never extracted. This is inferred from the diff and was not run.
